scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard anything yet.
dialogue.agent: I can help you with that. To access your loan application details, please provide me with your loan ID.

dialogue.user: I don't have my loan ID handy right now. Is there another way you can look up my application? I believe I applied for a conventional loan for refinancing. The loan amount was for $1,145,000 and the term was 60 months.
dialogue.agent:
I can look up your application using the details you've provided. One moment please.

I have located your application. The action taken on your loan application was that it was originated.

dialogue.user: Originated? What does that mean exactly? Does it mean it was approved?
dialogue.agent: Yes, "originated" means that your loan application was approved.

dialogue.user:
Oh, that's great news! Thank you for letting me know.

So, since it was approved, what are the interest rate and total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 7.550%. The record does not contain information on the total loan costs.

dialogue.user: That interest rate seems a bit high. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is classified as "Not applicable" for HOEPA status. It also does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user:
Okay, that's a relief. I was worried about those.

Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The purchaser type for your loan is listed as "Not applicable." This means your loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> - I'm satisfied with the interaction because you were able to tell me the status of my application, that it was approved, and provide details about the interest rate and flags. While I would have liked to know the total loan costs, I understand that information wasn't available in the system. You answered my questions promptly and clearly.
